response.text: {"verdict": "not_covered", "clause_ids": ["A5.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for unstable angina, which is described as a pre-existing condition (known arterial hypertension treated since 2024 and a cardiology check-up two months ago for chest pain).
